svg.text: Quality depends on how you chunk and index, which retriever you use (exact words vs

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: meaning), and whether the agent decides when to search.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: RAG 在提问时去检索相关内容，而不是让模型死记硬背。效果取决于怎么分块和建索引、用哪种检索

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 器（精确词匹配还是语义匹配），以及智能体能否自己决定何时检索。
